effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
[On Play] You may place 1 [Kinkakumon] and 1 [Ginkakumon] from your trash in this card's digivolution cards in any order. If you place 2 cards with this effect, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
